title: Bucharest doubles paid public parking spaces over last two years
summary: The number of paid public parking spaces in Bucharest has doubled over the past two years, according to data presented on Thursday, October 29, by the Bucharest City Hall. In June 2024, Bucharest had 23,312 paid public parking spaces, compared to 52,195 currently, representing an increase of approximately 108%. During the same period, the number of parking transactions increased from 589,007 in June 2024 to 1,031,639 in June 2026, by approximately 75%. The increase is also visible compared to last year. In June 2025, 33,554 paid public parking spaces were available, and the number of recorded transactions stood at 746,796. One year later, the number of spaces had increased by more than 55%,

items.title: Bucharest doubles paid public parking spaces over last two years
